events.summary: Speaker A stated the project aim is a new remote control that has to be original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: It has to be original, trendy, and user friendly

events.summary: Speaker A reported a fault on the corporate website: it said Real Remote instead of Real Reaction.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: there was Real Remote instead of Real Reaction

events.summary: Speaker A set the project method: functional design with individual work and meetings, then conceptual and detailed design.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: First is functional des uh design, individual work, meetings

events.summary: Speaker A said the selling price is 25 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: a selling price is uh twenty five Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said the profit aim is fifty million Euros, the least the company must get from the remote controls.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Our profit aim is fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said the production cost can be at most twelve and a half Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Our production cost um can be maximal twelve and a half Euros

events.summary: Speaker A proposed an international product, focused on different users, cultures and trends.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we have to focus on different kind of users, different kind of cultures

events.summary: Speaker D proposed one remote control that can operate all of the household devices, such as TV, video recorder and DVD player.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: make one remote control that can operate them all

events.summary: Speaker A supported Speaker D: putting different kinds of devices in one remote makes it much easier.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: if you can put different kind of devices in one remote control, it makes it a lot easier as well

events.summary: Speaker A proposed looking at using infrared to control devices in other rooms.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we can maybe see if we can do something with the infra-red

events.summary: Speaker A objected that the infrared feature may exceed the production costs.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: But I don't know if that will exceed the production costs

events.summary: Speaker D proposed that the remote has to be shock proof, because the remote tends to fall.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: Think it has to be shock proof

events.summary: Speaker A committed to put the minutes of this meeting in the project folder.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I will put the minutes from this meeting uh in our project folder

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a battery status display, to show how much charge is left.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: to put a battery status display on it

events.summary: Speaker D objected that a battery display would drag up the production costs.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: But they'll also really drag up the production costs

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a little LED instead of a full battery display.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: But maybe just a little LED, I don't know
